# Team export FAQ

**Can I download a CSV?** Yes. Team accounts can download CSV exports and schedule daily CSV exports.

**Is API export available?** No. It is planned but has no committed release date.

**Does Team include single sign-on?** No, not currently.

**What if a scheduled export fails?** Contact support with the job ID so the team can inspect it. Recovery time is not guaranteed.
